title: How do they make these fruit videos
search_title: how to make AI fruit videos

yell.text: My whole For You page is these fruit soap operas and I STILL don't know how they make them!

clip.says: You've had three jobs since that photo.

steps.text: Step one: open Zyvo and pick AI Fruit Story.
Step two: pick an idea, or type your own.
Step three: it draws it, animates it and voices it.

visual.label: MY REAL RUN: FIRST CLICK TO VIDEO

punchline.text: …so THAT'S how they post every day.

end.text: It's called Zyvo. Link in bio. Comment FRUIT and tell me your idea.

caption: My whole For You page is fruit soap operas 🍓 So THAT'S how they make them… How to make AI fruit videos: link in bio.
